propositions: The legacy inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after successful new-writer saves while maintaining compatibility with A2-1-or-newer binaries.

Successful persistence must atomically merge staged inline values into the sidecar using chronological max, persist get_rotation.json, then remove inline last_get_pass and write bindings.json only after sidecar persistence succeeds.
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value preserved as a failure floor for recovery on retry.
After sidecar replace succeeds but before bindings replace fails, the maximum rotation value must remain durable in the sidecar so no data is lost on crash or rollback.
Mixed old-writer and new-writer sequences must converge by promoting any later legacy inline stamp into get_rotation.json and scrubbing the inline field on the next new-writer save.
